content.value_statement: RWA projects often lack clear asset, legal, technical, and operating structures. This skill organizes those decisions into a compliance-focused plan with defined deliverables.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates asset eligibility using ownership, value, income, demand, and divisibility criteria.
Designs ownership, income-right, or usage-right token structures and distribution mechanisms.
Compares domestic digitization with offshore issuance routes and identifies required legal review.
Outlines blockchain, token standard, smart contract, custody, and reserve-proof requirements.
Produces whitepaper structures, due diligence lists, issuance plans, and ongoing management checklists.
limitations: It does not provide binding legal, tax, securities, or regulatory advice.
Its regulatory references may become outdated and require verification with local counsel.
It does not deploy smart contracts, issue tokens, custody assets, or execute transactions.
Recommendations depend on complete ownership, valuation, investor, and jurisdiction information.

use_cases.title: Screen a Candidate Asset
use_cases.description: Assess whether an asset meets basic RWA criteria and identify evidence gaps before structuring begins.

use_cases.title: Compare Issuance Routes
use_cases.description: Compare domestic digitization and offshore token issuance paths, including legal, KYC, custody, and disclosure requirements.

use_cases.title: Plan Technical Delivery
use_cases.description: Translate a proposed rights structure into token, contract, custody, audit, and operating requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Check Asset Eligibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this asset for RWA suitability: [asset details]. List each eligibility criterion, available evidence, missing evidence, risks, and a recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner screening before detailed advisory work

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Token Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Design three structures for [asset]. Compare tokenized rights, unit economics, distributions, transfer controls, investor eligibility, custody, and major risks.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Compliance Workplan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a compliance workplan for [asset], [owner jurisdiction], [issuance jurisdiction], and [investor group]. Include counsel questions, KYC, disclosures, approvals, and stop conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Create an End-to-End Blueprint
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop an RWA blueprint for [project]. Cover eligibility, rights, SPV, regulation, technology, custody, issuance, reporting, timeline, dependencies, controls, and professional reviews.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a portfolio of solar lease receivables for tokenization.
output_examples.output: The assessment separates ownership evidence, cash-flow history, valuation, servicing, transfer restrictions, and concentration risk. It ends with evidence requests and decision gates.

output_examples.input: Compare a domestic digital certificate with an offshore income-right token.
output_examples.output: The comparison covers investor access, transferability, legal entities, securities review, KYC, custody, disclosures, operating cost, and conditions requiring local counsel.

output_examples.input: Prepare a delivery plan for an ERC-3643 RWA project.
output_examples.output: The plan defines identity controls, allowlists, transfer rules, contract audit, asset custody, reserve reporting, incident procedures, milestones, owners, and acceptance checks.

best_practices: Provide verified ownership, valuation, cash-flow, jurisdiction, and investor information before requesting a recommendation.
Treat compliance and ownership as decision gates before technical design or fundraising.
Ask licensed local counsel, auditors, valuers, and custodians to validate every implementation plan.
anti_patterns: Do not treat general guidance as legal approval for an offering or investor solicitation.
Do not promise liquidity, capital protection, fixed returns, or regulatory acceptance.
Do not design token economics before confirming asset rights, transferability, and enforceability.

faq.question: What assets can this skill assess?
faq.answer: It can assess data, receivables, commodities, intellectual property, environmental assets, and other assets with documented rights and measurable value.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning guidance and questions for qualified counsel, regulators, auditors, valuers, and custodians.

faq.question: Can it choose an issuance jurisdiction?
faq.answer: It can compare options using supplied facts. Local counsel must confirm securities, tax, licensing, marketing, and investor rules.

faq.question: Can it write a smart contract?
faq.answer: It can define contract requirements and controls. Development, testing, deployment, and independent security auditing remain separate professional tasks.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide asset rights, ownership records, valuation, cash flows, locations, target investors, funding goals, transfer limits, and preferred jurisdictions.

faq.question: How current is the regulatory guidance?
faq.answer: The knowledge base has a stated reference date. Verify every rule and policy source before relying on it.
